name: meituan
description: Browser automation skill for Meituan food delivery and local services. Search restaurants, browse menus, check reviews, compare delivery options, and generate order previews.
author: harrylabsj

features.name: search-restaurants
features.description: Search for restaurants, stores, and local services by name, cuisine, or category

features.name: browse-menus
features.description: View menu items, prices, descriptions, and available options

features.name: check-reviews
features.description: View merchant ratings, review counts, and customer feedback

features.name: compare-delivery
features.description: Compare delivery time, delivery fee, minimum order, and promotions across merchants

features.name: add-to-cart
features.description: Add items to cart with options/variants selected

features.name: apply-coupons
features.description: Check available coupons, red packets, and promotion conditions

features.name: order-preview
features.description: Preview order total with all fees, discounts, and final price
